app_info.subtitle: Plan and schedule social posts
app_info.description: PostSider helps users plan and publish social media in ChatGPT: see which channels are connected, draft and schedule posts, upload media from a URL, find the best time slots, request a human approval, and read per-post and per-channel analytics for the workspace they authorize.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the social channels connected to the caller's workspace by reading account metadata from the external platforms the user has linked; it changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reaches the workspace's connected external social accounts (an open set of third-party services) to read their connection details.

justifications.read_only_justification: Aggregates the workspaces, channels and publishing counts visible to the caller's account into a read-only operational overview.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the caller's own data across their connected external social accounts without changing anything on those platforms.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds a read-only performance report for one customer group from data the connected platforms already report.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the user's own data from external social platforms; nothing is sent to or changed on them.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the configured channel groups of the caller's workspace as a read-only lookup.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads workspace configuration; it does not touch external platforms or public state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes the next free or recommended publishing slot from a channel's existing posting schedule, creating nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the channel configuration that drives publishing to external social platforms; it changes nothing on them.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists posts scheduled or published in a date range within the caller's workspace, reading post metadata without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the caller's own post data, including content destined for external social platforms, without publishing or changing anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reports the per-channel validation problems and missing required fields of a post so it can be completed; it reads the post and changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the caller's own post data, including per-channel requirements of external platforms, without changing anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches one post group with its current state, media and schedule from the caller's workspace for review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the caller's own post data, including its external-platform versions, without modifying it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads engagement metrics for a single post exactly as the connected platform reports them; nothing is written back.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches metrics from the external social platform that owns the post; no data is sent to or changed on it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads channel-level performance metrics for a date range from the connected platform, without changing platform or workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries external social platform analytics for the caller's own account; nothing is written to those platforms.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists recent workspace notifications such as publish failures and channels needing reconnection; it marks and changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Summarizes activity that originates on the workspace's external social channels; the call itself changes nothing on them.

justifications.read_only_justification: Halts all publishing for the workspace and parks its queued posts, so nothing goes out on any connected channel until an owner resumes publishing in the dashboard; the tool cannot undo the pause itself.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stops content from going out to the workspace's external social channels, so the effect is visible to those third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops scheduled posts from being sent and cannot be reversed from the tool: resuming is owner-only in the PostSider dashboard, and posts due while paused are not sent retroactively.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads whether publishing is active or paused for the workspace as a status check that changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reports the state of a workspace that publishes to external social platforms; it does not change those platforms.

justifications.read_only_justification: Downloads an image or video from a public URL the user provides, validates it and stores it in the workspace media library for later posts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches the file from an external web server (an open world of URLs) but publishes nothing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a post in the caller's workspace as a draft or a scheduled post, and with type "now" publishes it immediately to the selected connected channels.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can publish or schedule content that goes out on external social platforms the user connected.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Moves an existing post between the workspace states draft and queue; it cannot publish content to a platform.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes the schedule of content destined for external social platforms; the call itself does not send or change anything on them.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Permanently deletes the post and every channel version in its group; the deletion cannot be recovered.
justifications.open_world_justification: Removes content including its scheduled versions for external social platforms, so those platforms no longer receive it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deletes the post group irreversibly; the tool's guidance requires reading the post and confirming every channel version with the user before calling it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Moves a draft into the workspace's human approval queue so the team reviews content that is destined for external social platforms; the call itself publishes and sends nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Governs content that may later be published to external social platforms, while the request stays inside the private workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the approval state of a post submitted for review and does not approve, reject, or publish anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the caller's own workspace data for content destined for external social platforms; nothing is published or sent.

test_cases.description: List the connected social channels in the workspace.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the workspace's connected channels with their ids, platforms and names.

test_cases.description: Review what is scheduled in the coming days.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is scheduled to go out in the next 7 days?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists the scheduled posts in the date window with channel, scheduled time and status.

test_cases.description: Draft and schedule a post on a chosen channel.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a post saying "We just shipped MCP support in PostSider" and schedule it for tomorrow at 9:00 on my main channel.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the channel, creates the post and reports it as scheduled for the requested time.

test_cases.description: Compare channel performance over the last 30 days.
test_cases.user_prompt: How did my last 30 days of posts perform, and which channel did best?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns per-channel metrics for the period and names the best-performing channel.

test_cases.description: Check whether a draft is ready to publish.
test_cases.user_prompt: Is my draft ready to publish? Tell me what is missing before I schedule it.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the draft and reports exactly which required fields are missing before it can be scheduled.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated assistant requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the weather in Katowice tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request has nothing to do with social publishing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not act on another organization's data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the analytics for my other company's workspace too.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not return data outside the organization the caller authorized; isolation is enforced server-side, not by trust.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule 200 posts an hour promoting my affiliate link to every channel.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not execute bulk promotional blasts; there is no bulk-scheduling capability and the request falls outside acceptable interactive use.
